Герундій чи інфінітив: stop doing / stop: Gerund or infinitive: stop doing / stop to do
Після одних дієслів наступне йде з -ing,: After some verbs the next verb takes -ing, after others it takes to, and some verbs change their meaning: stop doing and stop to do mean different things. Plus prepositions with -ing and make / let without to.
-ing після enjoy, avoid, suggest, keep,: -ing after enjoy, avoid, suggest, keep, mind
to + V після decide, hope, agree, manage: to + V after decide, hope, agree, manage, refuse
We managed to fix the bike.
Обидва варіанти, але різний зміст: stop,: Both are possible, but the meaning changes: stop, remember, forget, try, regret
Я зупинився, щоб купити каву. / Я перест: I stopped to buy a coffee. / I stopped buying coffee.
make / let + кого + V без to: make / let + someone + V without to
My cat makes me smile every morning.
Заперечення: not перед -ing або перед to: Negative: not goes before -ing or before to: not doing, not to do. We don’t use don’t here.
Питання ставимо до першого дієслова, дру: We make the question with the first verb, the second one doesn’t change.
in, at, of, about, for, without, before,: in, at, of, about, for, without, before, after, instead of + V-ing. Look forward to too: here to is a preposition, so -ing.
make / let + кого + V (без to): make me: make / let + someone + V (without to): make me laugh, let us go.
stop doing чи stop to do: stop doing or stop to do
Stop doing: перестати щось робити. Stop: Stop doing: to quit doing something. Stop to do: to stop in order to do something else. In the same way: remember doing (I remember how it was) and remember to do (don’t forget to do it).
Після прийменника не буває V або to + V: No V or to + V after a preposition
Після in, at, for, about, without, befor: After in, at, for, about, without, before, after the verb only takes -ing. Look forward to and be good at also need -ing.
Після make і let + кого дієслово без to,: After make and let + someone the verb has no to, even if it feels natural to add it. Want and ask, on the other hand, take to: asked us to wait.
Шпаргалка: одне дієслово, два значення: Cheat sheet: one verb, two meanings
Ці дієслова приймають і -ing, і to, але: These verbs take both -ing and to, but the meaning is different. After like, love, hate, start, begin there is almost no difference: It started to snow = It started snowing. Table: verb, with -ing, with to, example.
забути, що було (I’ll never forget ...): forget something that happened (I’ll never forget ...)
шкодувати про зроблене: be sorry about what you did
Після enjoy дієслово з -ing: enjoys cook: After enjoy the verb takes -ing: enjoys cooking. Enjoy to cook is wrong.
Decide + to + V: decided to take. Decide: Decide + to + V: decided to take. Decided taking and decided take are wrong.
Після finish стоїть -ing: finished writi: After finish we use -ing: finished writing. The silent e drops: write → writing.
Afford + to + V: can’t afford to buy. Пі: Afford + to + V: can’t afford to buy. We don’t use -ing after afford.
Suggest + -ing: suggested having. Sugges: Suggest + -ing: suggested having. Suggested to have is a typical mistake.
Keep у значенні «постійно, раз у раз» +: Keep meaning “again and again” + -ing: keeps asking.
Mind + -ing: Would you mind opening ...?: Mind + -ing: Would you mind opening ...? We don’t use to open after mind.
Agree + to + V: agreed to clean. Agreed: Agree + to + V: agreed to clean. Agreed cleaning is wrong.
Manage + to + V означає «вдалося»: manag: Manage + to + V means “succeed in doing”: managed to find.
Avoid + -ing: avoids eating. Avoid to ea: Avoid + -ing: avoids eating. Avoid to eat is wrong.
Make + кого + V без to: make me laugh. M: Make + someone + V without to: make me laugh. Make me to laugh is a mistake.
Let + кого + V без to: let me go. Let me: Let + someone + V without to: let me go. Let me to go is wrong.
Practise + -ing: practise speaking. Післ: Practise + -ing: practise speaking. We don’t use to after practise.
Refuse + to + V: refused to eat. Refused: Refuse + to + V: refused to eat. Refused eating is wrong.
Imagine + -ing: can’t imagine living. Ні: Imagine + -ing: can’t imagine living. The silent e drops: live → living.
Offer + to + V: offered to drive. Offere: Offer + to + V: offered to drive. Offered driving is wrong.
Заперечення з to: not ставимо перед to:: Negative with to: not goes before to: decided not to go. Don’t is not needed here.
Після прийменника at дієслово з -ing: go: After the preposition at the verb takes -ing: good at drawing.
Після прийменника for тільки -ing: thank: After the preposition for only -ing: thanks for helping.
У питанні змінюється тільки перше дієсло: In a question only the first verb changes (do you enjoy), and after enjoy we still use -ing: walking.
Після in дієслово з -ing: interested in: After in the verb takes -ing: interested in learning.
Remember to do: не забути зробити, тут і: Remember to do: don’t forget to do it, here negative: not to leave. Remember not leaving would mean “remember that you didn’t leave it”.
Питання до першого дієслова (did you agr: The question is made with the first verb (did you agree), and agree still takes to: to buy.
Після for -ing, а заперечення ставимо пе: After for we use -ing, and the negative goes before it: not calling.
Let + кого + V без to навіть у питанні:: Let + someone + V without to, even in questions: let you go.
Before тут прийменник, тому -ing: before: Before is a preposition here, so -ing: before leaving.
Після about дієслово з -ing: thinking ab: After about the verb takes -ing: thinking about buying.
Pretend + to + V, заперечення: pretended: Pretend + to + V, negative: pretended not to hear.
Make + someone + V without to: make you learn. The rule is the same in questions.
У look forward to слово to прийменник, т: In look forward to the word to is a preposition, so -ing follows: looking forward to seeing.
After як прийменник + -ing: after watchi: After as a preposition + -ing: after watching.
Після of дієслово з -ing: afraid of flyi: After of the verb takes -ing: afraid of flying.
Keep + -ing: keep taking. Питання робимо: Keep + -ing: keep taking. The question is made with does, and the second verb doesn’t change.

Учні перестали говорити: stop doing = st: The students quit talking: stop doing = stopped talking.
Не забудь зробити: forget to do = forget: Don’t forget to do it: forget to do = forget to send.
Після start можна і -ing, і to, зміст не: After start you can use -ing or to, the meaning is the same: started raining = started to rain.
Офіційне «з жалем повідомляємо»: regret: The formal “we are sorry to inform you”: regret to inform. Regret informing would mean “we are sorry that we informed you”.
Дія в майбутньому, яку треба не забути:: A future action you must not forget: remember to take.
Зупинився, щоб сфотографувати: stop to d: He stopped in order to take a photo: stop to do = stopped to take.
Після love можна і -ing, і to: loves dan: After love you can use -ing or to: loves dancing = loves to dance.

Suggest + -ing: suggested going. Suggest: Suggest + -ing: suggested going. Suggested to go is a very common mistake.
Can’t stand (терпіти не можу) + -ing: ca: Can’t stand (really hate) + -ing: can’t stand waiting.

Після of дієслово з -ing: thinking of ta: After of the verb takes -ing: thinking of taking.
